options.description: The turn-end line says which behaviour stopped working and was hidden, with no question count. The agent is still blocked once and asks you through the question tool. This matches 'the line still names a behaviour that stopped working'. It costs a small change to the line code.
options.label: Name it in the line (Recommended)

options.description: Nothing appears at the turn end. You hear about it only when the agent asks you through the question tool. That example in the requirement gets reworded to say so.
options.label: No line, agent asks

payload.question: When the agent rewrites a test so a broken behaviour looks fixed (a hidden regression), should your end-of-turn plumb line still mention it, now that the line no longer counts questions?
